title: A GMP-Compliant Procedure for the Generation of Gene-Modified T cells
protocol: Collect cells from the donor apheresis bag into 50 mL tubes, depending on the initial volume.
Perform two washes of the cell bag by infusing 15 mL of complete hematopoietic media (+5% HSA).
Conduct polysaccharide-based density gradient centrifugation at a 1:2 (reagent:sample) dilution.
Centrifuge at 800 x g for 30 min at room temperature with breaks off.
Collect PBMCs into a clean 50 mL tube using a micropipette.
Wash the cells twice with 1x PBS, filling up to 50 mL for each wash (400 x g, 10 min, room temperature).
Resuspend the cells in 5 mL of complete media.
Count the cells using trypan blue.
Dilute the cells with complete media to achieve a concentration of 2 x 10^6 cells/mL.
Activate 20 x 10^6 PBMCs by adding 10 µL of T cell stimulation reagent per 2 x 10^6 starting cells.
Add rhIL-2 (20 U/mL), mix gently, and transfer the mixture into an appropriate vessel.
Incubate the cells at 37 °C, 5% CO2 for 72 h.
Transfer the cell culture into a suitable vessel, such as a 50 mL conical tube.
Mix well and centrifuge at 300 x g for 10 min at room temperature (RT) to remove the activation reagent.
Carefully discard the supernatant completely.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of complete medium.
Resuspend the cells in complete medium to achieve a concentration that allows plating 0.5 x 10^6 cells in a total volume of 400 μL per well in a 24-well plate.
Add rhIL-7 at 155 U/mL and rhIL-15 at 290 U/mL to the cell suspension.
Prepare Vectofusin-1 by adding it to Opti-MEM medium at a concentration of 10 μg/mL, with a volume equal to the viral volume to be used.
Combine the concentrated virus at an MOI of 40 with the Vectofusin-1/Opti-MEM mixture in a 1:1 ratio and mix thoroughly.
Add this mixture to the cell culture and adjust the total volume to 400 μL per well using complete medium if necessary.
Place the lid on the plate, seal it with paraffin film, and centrifuge at 1000 x g for 2 h at 32 °C.
Incubate the plate at 37 °C, 5% CO2 overnight.
Collect the cells and pool them into a suitable vessel such as a 50 mL tube on Day 4.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 x g at room temperature for 5 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant completely and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of complete media.
Count the cells using trypan blue.
Resuspend the cells in complete media at a concentration of 1 x 10^6 cells/mL.
Add rhIL-7 (155 U/mL) and rhIL-15 (290 U/mL).
Transfer the cells to an appropriate vessel, such as a T25 flask, at a concentration of 0.3-0.5 x 10^6 cells/cm^2.
Incubate the cells at 37 °C with 5% CO2 for 2 days.
Harvest the cells when the desired cell number is reached.
Transfer harvested cells to 50 mL tubes, adjusting tube number based on total volume.
Centrifuge the tubes at 400 x g at room temperature (RT) for 5 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant completely.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of media if necessary.
Pool cells from multiple tubes as needed.
Count the cells using trypan blue again.
Keep an aliquot of 1 x 10^6 cells for quality control (QC) testing.
Centrifuge the tubes at 400 x g for 10 min at RT.
Completely remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in a cryopreservation solution consisting of 50% HSA and 40% HBSS at a concentration of 1 x 10^7 cells per mL per cryovial.
Transfer the cell suspension into the appropriate number of cryovials.
Add 10% dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) to each cryovial.
Place the cryovials on ice.
Promptly transfer the cryovials to a controlled-rate freezer for cryopreservation.
After cryopreservation, transfer the cryovials to a monitored liquid nitrogen tank for long-term storage.
Perform transduction efficiency-flow cytometry staining (Day 14).
Place an aliquot of 1 x 10^6 cells in a FACS tube.
Add 500 μL of FACS buffer and centrifuge the tube at 400 x g at room temperature for 5 min.
Completely discard the supernatant with a pipette.
Resuspend the pellet in a 1:5 diluted solution of CD3:FACS buffer.
Vortex the sample and incubate for 30 min on ice in the dark.
Add 500 μL of FACS buffer and centrifuge at 400 x g for 5 min at room temperature.
Completely discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in a 1:20 diluted solution of 7-AAD:FACS buffer.
Vortex the sample and incubate for 10 min on ice in the dark.
Add 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Analyze the sample using a flow cytometer.
